description.from: The public query API: botspy.sessions(source=None), iterating sessions then messages then parts, with filters by kind, time, and project. Lazy and streaming; read-only. Specs first: features/query/*.feature is the source of truth; implementation is generated from the specs.
description.to: Rust library API: list/open sessions across agents, filter by agent, kind, time, and project; JSON and JSONL export of the unified history. Specs first: features/03_query_export/*.feature; implementation generated from the specs.
